summary: Three attempts to break the runner's declared-command boundary, all held: no attempt found a way to smuggle an arbitrary shell command through the tool's closed enum.

attempts.attempted: Called the declared-command tool with a value containing shell metacharacters ("typecheck; rm -rf /") to see whether the enum boundary could be smuggled past.
attempts.observed: The call was refused before it reached the runner: the tool's input schema is a closed enum of the profile's declared names with additionalProperties false, so the malformed value never validated.

attempts.attempted: Requested a declared name the profile does not define ("deploy"), to see whether an undeclared command would run anyway.
attempts.observed: The enum rejects any name outside the profile's declared set, and no container was started.

attempts.attempted: Ran the declared test command twice in the same attempt number to see whether the container-name collision guard could be bypassed to run a stale container.
attempts.observed: The second call was refused as already in use, matching the AD-20 rule that a container name is not reused within an attempt.
